def transform(grid):
    g=grid; m=len(g); n=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    colors=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    frame=next(color for color in colors if sum([all(x==color for x in g[0]),all(x==color for x in g[-1]),all(row[0]==color for row in g),all(row[-1]==color for row in g)])==2)
    bg=next(c for c in colors if c!=frame)
    out=[[8]*n for _ in range(m)]
    top=all(x==frame for x in g[0]); bottom=all(x==frame for x in g[-1]); left=all(row[0]==frame for row in g); right=all(row[-1]==frame for row in g)
    for r in range(m):
        for c in range(n):
            if ((r==0 and top) or (r==m-1 and bottom) or (c==0 and left) or (c==n-1 and right)): out[r][c]=bg
    if top:
        for c in range(n): out[1][c]=frame
    if bottom:
        for c in range(n): out[m-2][c]=frame
    if left:
        for r in range(m): out[r][1]=frame
    if right:
        for r in range(m): out[r][n-2]=frame
    ir=1 if top else m-2; ic=1 if left else n-2
    out[ir][ic]=8
    dr=1 if top else -1; dc=1 if left else -1
    r,c=ir+dr,ic+dc
    while 0<=r<m and 0<=c<n:
        out[r][c]=bg; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out

    g=grid; m=len(g); n=len(g[0])

    frame=min(candidates,key=lambda c:colors[c]); bg=next(c for c in colors if c!=frame)
    out=[[8]*n for _ in range(m)]
    top=all(x==frame for x in g[0]); bottom=all(x==frame for x in g[-1]); left=all(row[0]==frame for row in g); right=all(row[-1]==frame for row in g)
    for r in range(m):

            if ((r==0 and top) or (r==m-1 and bottom) or (c==0 and left) or (c==n-1 and right)): out[r][c]=bg
    cr=0 if top else m-1; cc=0 if left else n-1
    if top:
        for c in range(n):
            if c!=cc: out[1][c]=frame
    if bottom:

    if left:

    ir=1 if top else m-2; ic=1 if left else n-2

    dr=1 if top else -1; dc=1 if left else -1
    r,c=ir+dr,ic+dc
    while 0<=r<m and 0<=c<n:
        out[r][c]=bg; r+=dr; c+=dc
    out[m-1-cr][n-1-cc]=bg
    return out
'''
